name: Turnstile client widget mount with elicited sitekey and third-party script pin
purpose: The client-side widget mount module for Cloudflare Turnstile. Mounts the Turnstile widget on elicited surfaces with the elicited TURNSTILE_SITEKEY. Injects only Cloudflare Turnstile JS from the Cloudflare Turnstile host (https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/api.js per https://developers.cloudflare.com/turnstile/) and no other third-party script. Populates the hidden cf-turnstile-response token field on submit. Widget mode is per ADR-3602 (managed, non-interactive, invisible).
responsibilities: Render the Turnstile widget on every elicited surface with the elicited TURNSTILE_SITEKEY (AC-35101-1).
Inject only Cloudflare Turnstile JS from the Cloudflare Turnstile host; refuse any other third-party script.
Populate the hidden cf-turnstile-response token field on the form payload before submit fires.
Honour the elicited widget mode enum: managed, non-interactive, invisible (AC-35106-1).
internalStructure: One client module realising the Turnstile mount. In the pack fixture the mount is inline in the served HTML for auditability; in an applied Workers project the mount ships as a small module the operator drops into the elicited surface.

interfaces.name: mountTurnstile
interfaces.summary: Mount the Turnstile widget onto a target element with the elicited sitekey and widget mode.
